subject: ADS software may cause lane-line crossings near intersections
summary: Automated driving software could cause a vehicle to cross a center line or enter an oncoming path near intersections.

subject: ADS may not detect people immediately next to the vehicle
summary: ADS could allow vehicle movement after failing to detect a person very close to the vehicle.
remedy: Zoox reported implementing the remedy on affected vehicles by May 21, 2025.

subject: ADS prediction error may prevent avoiding a collision
summary: A vehicle emerging from a perpendicular driveway could be incorrectly predicted to enter the driving lane.
remedy: Zoox reported updating operating vehicles by April 17, 2025.

subject: Unexpected hard braking
summary: Zoox ADS may brake hard unexpectedly near certain motorcycles or cyclists.
